title: The password
starting_code: # Walk to the gate, say the password, and walk through.
hints: You need three instructions: one to reach the gate, one to speak, and one to walk through.
First use `move_right` to take five steps. Then use `say`!
Give `say` a string with the word *ambrel* inside quotes, then use `move_right` again.
intro: An older pupil told me the password for the gate! It is *ambrel*. Stand right beside the gate, say the word, and walk through!
outro: The gate opened! We are inside the gatehouse. Look, I left something for you on that flat stone.
learned: Now you know what a string is, and how to make your wizard say things.
